cases.name: CHK-002:happy:0 - DEV advance hint contains docs
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-c2h0",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:["docs/foo.md"]},{title:"b",relatedDocs:["docs/bar.md"]}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const out = await $handlers.story_advance({storyId:id,phase:"DEV"}); if (!out.includes("docs/foo.md") || !out.includes("docs/bar.md") || !out.includes("\u5173\u8054\u6587\u6863")) throw new Error("missing docs in hint: "+out); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-002:edge:0 - dedupe across items
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-c2e0",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:["docs/shared.md"]},{title:"b",relatedDocs:["docs/shared.md"]}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const out = await $handlers.story_advance({storyId:id,phase:"DEV"}); const matches = out.match(/docs\/shared\.md/g); if (!matches || matches.length !== 1) throw new Error("not deduped: "+(matches?matches.length:0)); if (!out.includes("CHK-001") || !out.includes("CHK-002")) throw new Error("missing item refs"); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-002:edge:1 - no relatedDocs no doc section
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-c2e1",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a"},{title:"b"}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const out = await $handlers.story_advance({storyId:id,phase:"DEV"}); if (out.includes("\u5173\u8054\u6587\u6863")) throw new Error("unexpected doc section: "+out); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-002:edge:2 - partial coverage
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-c2e2",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:["only.md"]},{title:"b"}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const out = await $handlers.story_advance({storyId:id,phase:"DEV"}); if (!out.includes("only.md") || !out.includes("CHK-001")) throw new Error("missing"); if (out.includes("(CHK-002)")) throw new Error("unexpected CHK-002 in doc list"); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-001:happy:0 - story_create with relatedDocs
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-h0",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:["docs/foo.md","docs/bar.md"]}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const cl = $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:id}); const docs = cl.items[0].relatedDocs; if (!docs || docs.length !== 2 || docs[0] !== "docs/foo.md") throw new Error("wrong: "+JSON.stringify(docs)); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-001:happy:1 - checklist_update relatedDocs
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-h1",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a"}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; await $handlers.checklist_update({storyId:id,itemId:"CHK-001",relatedDocs:["updated.md"]}); const cl = $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:id}); if (cl.items[0].relatedDocs[0] !== "updated.md") throw new Error("wrong"); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-001:edge:0 - empty array
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-e0",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:[]}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const cl = $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:id}); if (!Array.isArray(cl.items[0].relatedDocs) || cl.items[0].relatedDocs.length !== 0) throw new Error("wrong"); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-001:edge:2 - undefined when omitted
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-e2",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a"}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const cl = $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:id}); if (cl.items[0].relatedDocs !== undefined) throw new Error("should be undefined"); return "ok"

cases.name: CHK-001:adversarial:2 - 100 docs preserved
cases.execute: const docs = Array.from({length:100},(_,i)=>`docs/f${i}.md`); const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"rd-a2",title:"t",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"DEV",checklist:[{title:"a",relatedDocs:docs}]}); const id = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; const cl = $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:id}); if (cl.items[0].relatedDocs.length !== 100 || cl.items[0].relatedDocs[99] !== "docs/f99.md") throw new Error("truncated"); return "ok"
